purpose: PU-1 registry closure map: deterministic mapping from ingestion hosts / vendor-SDK imports / snapshot modules to licence-registry source_ids. Verified by apps/backend/scripts/check_pu1_registry_closure.py; an unmapped source, or a mapped source with no registry row, fails the build. Entries marked judgement=true were mapped by the implementing session and are listed for owner review. MIXED entries (Alpaca broker API hosts / trading SDK) are classified per field via the field table; 'broker_field_access' makes any module that reads an AST-enforced market-data field name go through app.licensing.broker_fields or be allowlisted with a reason.

hosts.note: Quiver Quant (gov contracts, congress trades, lobbying)

mixed_hosts.note: Alpaca broker/trading API: owner transaction/account records AND marked-to-market market-data fields in the same response. Classified per field, never blanket NON_DATA; unlisted fields are alpaca_market_data (conservative).

mixed_imports.note: Alpaca trading SDK models (Position, TradeAccount, Order, ...): the same MIXED broker responses; classified per field, not blanket NON_DATA.

modules.note: consumes a frozen FRED DGS3MO snapshot (no network host in code)

broker_field_access.note: AST rule: a Python module under the scan roots that reads an ast_enforced_market_data_names field (attribute load, string subscript, or .get/.pop/.setdefault first argument) must CALL a broker_fields helper (classify_field / sources_of_fields / scope_of_fields / subset_with_lineage / taint_from_fields) or be listed here with a reason. Limits: dynamic getattr and constructed keys, keyword arguments, dict-literal keys, and fields reached through third-party model_dump are not caught; an in-file helper call does not prove every access is routed through it.
